last.verdict: Solid revenue growth, but a margin squeeze and China slump kept shares lower.

reasons.label: Margin slipped
reasons.text: Profit margin fell 0.34 points to 36.1% on higher marketing spend and commodity costs.

reasons.label: China sales collapse
reasons.text: China volumes fell 16.8% and its profit dropped 30.5%, which the company blamed on inventory management.

reasons.label: Weak North America
reasons.text: North America beer volumes fell 2.2%, and US revenue fell 1.2%.

story: Over the last few reports, growth has come from pricing, premium brands and a World Cup lift, while China and the US stayed weak. Full-year profit growth guidance has held at 4-8%. The stock rose modestly in July, then slipped this time.

history.verdict: Beat on profit and volumes, but a big run-up left only a small gain.

reasons.label: Profit beat
reasons.text: Organic operating profit rose 5.8%, above the 4.6% analysts expected.

reasons.label: World Cup volume lift
reasons.text: Volumes grew 0.9%, a second straight rise; management still expects a 25 basis point World Cup boost despite Brazil and Mexico exiting early.

reasons.label: Weak US and China
reasons.text: US sales to retailers and wholesalers fell, and China volumes dropped 9.7%.
